decisions.reason: As an extension of the firm’s established spraying systems that remained on the website in 2023 and 2024, it fits the core business and is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
Despite earlier test-phase wording, it had its own product page in both years and is close to the core injection business, so management would likely continue commercializing it.
This transfer pump builds directly on proven in-house components and the existing pump portfolio, making it a low-risk product to retain.
Although somewhat more specialized, it had dedicated website presence in both years and supports the firm’s move toward smarter, process-monitoring-oriented solutions.

As the newest launch with only limited website visibility so far, it carries the highest uncertainty, but its close fit with the established two-component spraying business argues for keeping it on the market.
